description:
£135 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this spacious six bedroom student property, ideally situated just minutes from the ever popular Osborne Road, with its fantastic selection of bars, restaurants and cafés.

The property boasts six generously sized double bedrooms, each complete with a flat-screen TV, arranged over two floors with three bedrooms on each level.

Further accommodation includes a large lounge, two modern bathrooms, an additional separate WC and stylish contemporary furnishings and décor throughout.

Perfectly positioned for student living, the property is within easy reach of Ilford Road Metro Station and a fantastic range of local amenities, including a post office, deli and convenience stores.

Offering spacious accommodation, modern interiors and a fantastic location, this property is ideal for students looking for convenience and comfort.

Interested in viewing? Contact the My Property Box lettings team today to arrange your viewing!
